measurement.name: Pocket occurrence
measurement.definition: fraction of evaluable RNA chain instances whose nucleotide at the consensus position lines at least one qualifying predicted pocket
measurement.evaluable: fpocketR run succeeded and the match residue has coordinates; deleted/uncovered positions and failed runs are outside the denominator

filters.all_score_ge_0: all pockets with fpocket Score >= 0 (fpocketR default qualityfilter 0.0)

method.input: ligand-free single RNA chain (polymer residues of label_asym_id, whole deposited construct, heavy atoms, highest-occupancy altloc, model 1, modified residues kept) from the PDBe updated mmCIF
method.pocket_nucleotides: residues of fpocket pockets/pocketN_atm.pdb (atoms contacted by the pocket's Voronoi vertices); no additional distance cut-off
method.mapping: author (chain, number, insertion code) -> label_seq_id via the input residue map, verified against InstanceIndex.resolve_unit; consensus positions from the validated family mapping

filters.all_score_ge_0: all pockets with fpocket Score >= 0 (fpocketR default qualityfilter 0.0)

method.volume_note: fpocket pocket volume is a Monte-Carlo estimate (about +/-3 % between runs); scores, alpha-sphere counts and lining atoms are deterministic
